text:
jess: Heads up — saw a regression on prod llm-v3-13b around 11:10a UTC. p95 up ~25% for short chat flows when chatpad is enabled + adaptive batching. Attaching quick trace dump.

matt: did it start after the kernel selector change yesterday? which kernel was picked?

jess: looks like it flipped to the fused-kv-path for many requests. selector log:
```
SELECT_KERNEL llm-v3-13b seq=48 batch=8 -> fused_kv_prefetch (heuristic score 0.72)
fallbacks: scalar_mm -> fused_kv_prefetch
```
latency trace excerpt (ms):
```
decode_start: 0
kv_fetch: 4.8
kernel_exec: 9.5
kernel_switch_overhead: 6.2
decode_end: 21.0
```

liam: that kernel_switch_overhead looks high. could be mismatch with rope_theta default leading to extra reshaping/permute ops.

sana: i also see increased memcpys in the NVTX profile when chatpad prefix length > 64. chat template pushes a long system prompt on some customers.

perf-bot: perf alert #8643 triggered: p95 latency +23% since 3135799000. Offender: kernel_selector v2.1.3.

jess: hypothesis: batching heuristic (adaptive batch = prefer larger batch for throughput) is combining chatpad-heavy and short requests, which forces fused_kv_prefetch kernel that expects contiguous KV layout; the prefix-induced rope scaling path does extra transposes when headdim mismatch occurs (rmsnorm-silu combo triggers alternate path). Net result: kernel warm/cold and more memcpy.

matt: can we repro locally with a mixture of short chatpad requests + some 1-token requests? i'll spin up a repro harness.

liam: quick patch idea: add a cheap pre-check in selector to avoid fused_kv_prefetch when avg_prefix_len > 64 or when rope_theta != model_default. cheap heuristic to prefer scalar_mm for low-latency short-convo cases.

sana: also worth checking KV cache attr: some sessions are evicting early because batch slicing leads to per-request KV allocation sizes that exceed our allocator watermark. logs show a few OOM retries.

jess: repro steps i used:
```
# 1. spawn runtime with kernel-selector=v2.1.3
# 2. send mix: 70% short chatpad (prefix 120 tokens), 30% very short (1-3) concurrently at qps=120
# 3. enable adaptive_batching with max_batch=16
```
results: p50 ~ stable, p95 spike only when fused_kv_prefetch chosen repeatedly for slices.

matt: good. if we can confirm, we'll push a canary with selector tweak and batching cap = 8 for llm-v3-13b.

liam: another angle — rope_theta defaults differ between the Llama 2 conversion we have and the community Llama 3 weights; if model metadata isn't normalized selector might be picking kernels assuming different RoPE scaling which causes extra rescale op at runtime.

sana: action items:
- liam: add selector guard for avg_prefix_len + rope_theta mismatch (ETA 2h)
- matt: run repro harness and attach full NVTX traces (ETA 3h)
- jess: prepare canary plan (limit adaptive_batching, pin kernel) and roll to one host pool (ETA 1h)
- perf-bot: keep monitoring p95 and memory retries

perf-bot: scheduled canary roll at 3135803000 -> target pool: eu-west-1a/gpu-pool-7

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: selector-guard/quickfix -> canary (1/5 hosts) by matt

jess: temporary mitigation worked in canary: p95 reduced back to baseline on the canary host. still need to validate at scale.

matt: if this is stable we'll bake heuristic into v2.1.4 and follow up with a selector test-suite scenario for mixed chatpad workloads.

liam: long-term we should keep kernel metadata tied to model's rope_theta and head/kv dim metadata at model onboarding time to avoid runtime surprises.

sana: noted — i'll add a model-ingestion check to warn when rope_theta is absent or ambiguous.

jess: thanks everyone. i'll keep this thread updated with canary numbers and NVTX links.
